narrative: Demand for PL3__M9CD9474 is highly variable (CV=1.48) with a lognormal profile and 29% intermittency across 228 working days. Lead times are volatile (CV=0.83), making the current zero-safety-stock SAP policy risky. The recommended (r,Q) policy with SS=449 and OQ=4773 reduces orders from ~28 to ~8 per year, delivering 41% cost savings while achieving 95% service level within 38.5% of storage capacity.
